class.name: OpenXRSpatialContextWaterTightMeshConfig
class.brief_description: Configuration structure to enable watertight meshes.
class.description: Configuration structure to enable watertight meshes. This can be added as a next structure to [OpenXRSpatialCapabilityConfigurationMeshTracking].

members.member: If [code]true[/code] we will request watertight meshes. Setting this to [code]false[/code] has the same behavior as not including this structure at all.
